name: Ellis Myers
bio: Ellis Torrence Myers (born around 2012) is an American SAG-AFTRA actor and voice performer with roots in the Chicago theater scene. He trained in acting, improvisation, Shakespeare, and musical theater at the Actors Training Center in Illinois, going on to appear in stage productions including Judgment Day at Chicago Shakespeare Theater, The Full Monty at Paramount Theatre, and King John at City Lit Theater. On screen, he portrayed Gabe Tannen in the feature film All Is Merry & Bright (2025) and voices Greg Heffley's eccentric neighbor Fregley in Disney's animated films Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Last Straw (2025) and Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway (2026).

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
credits.overview: With the stress of the holidays fast approaching, the Heffley family—to Greg's dismay—makes a last-minute decision to escape to an all-inclusive island resort for some much-needed rest and relaxation. As hilarious hijinks ensue, the Heffleys soon discover that paradise may not be everything it's cracked up to be.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Last Straw
credits.overview: When laidback Greg finds himself at odds with his dad's outsized expectations, pressure builds to turn his act around. After a series of hilarious near disasters, Greg's dad presents him with an ultimatum that just might challenge his wimpy ways for good.

credits.title: All Is Merry & Bright
credits.overview: A teen's dreams are shattered by a car crash. Years later, she's a determined supermom with a cane, orchestrating elaborate Christmas shows. Personal issues force her to confront change and rediscover the true spirit of the season.
